out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock, Retaining Labels/Tags for 90 Days
violations.observation: The tags for the molluscan shellfish (clams and oysters) are not being retained for 90 days.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels for 90 calendar days from the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served using one of the following methods: 1) an approved record keeping system that keeps the tags or labels in chronological order correlated to the date when the last shellstock from a container are sold or served, 2) preserving source identification by using a record keeping system, and 3) ensuring that shellstock from one tagged or labeled container are not commingled with shellstock from another container with different certification numbers, different harvest dates, or different growing areas as identified on the tag or label before being ordered by the consumer. Person in charge trained all staff present on proper marking and retention of shellstock tags.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED COCKROACHES ON THE FOLLOWING: -UNDERNEATH THE THREE-VAT SINK ON THREE STICKY TRAPS WERE AT LEAST ~50 DEAD AND ALIVE/MOVING COCKROACHES OF ALL LIFE STAGES. -TINY LIVE COCKROACHES UNDERNEATH A BOX ON THE GREASE TRAP. -A DEAD COCKROACH BEHIND GLASS OF THE MICROWAVE OVEN. -DEAD COCKROACH ON WALL BY DRY STORAGE SHELVING NEAR WALK-IN FREEZER -MULTIPLE DEAD COCKROACHES OF DIFFERENT SPECIES (SOME OVER 1IN LONG AND SOME SMALLER) ON STICKY TRAPS IN CLOSET WITH HOT WATER HEATER. -THERE WERE AT LEAST 8 STICKY TRAPS STUCK ON WALLS AND FLOOR OF HOT WATER HEATER ROOM. -OBSERVED DIFFERENT BRAND STICKY TRAPS THROUGHOUT FACILITY, BEHIND AND UNDERNEATH EQUIPMENT INCLUDING ON SHELVING BELOW THE MICROWAVE OVEN. OBSERVED THE COCKROACH DROPPINGS IN THE FOLLOWING PLACES: -ALONG MOST PLUMBING PIPING (INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO UNDER THREE-VAT SINK AND HANDWASHING SINKS) -BUILT UP AROUND THE HANDWASHING SINK IN KITCHEN -UNDERNEATH SHELVING, EQUIPMENT, BOXES -ON MOST WALLS IN KITCHEN -ALONG THE WALL ON THE FLOORS OWNER PROVIDED PEST CONTROL INVOICE FROM 12/17/2025. PEST CONTROL OPERATOR DID NOT NOTE CURRENT CONDITIONS OR OBSERVATIONS. OWNER STATED HE REPLACES ALL THE STICKY TRAPS HIMSELF AFTER THEY GET FULL.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. YOU MUST GET AN EMERGENCY PEST CONTROL SERVICE. FACILITY MUST BE TREATED FOR COCKROACHES ON A MUCH HIGHER FREQUENCY, NOT MERELY ONCE A MONTH. YOU MAY NOT APPLY ANY OF YOUR OWN PEST CONTROL INCLUDING STICKY TRAPS. CEASE DOING THIS IMMEDIATELY. ALL OF THE AREAS I’VE LISTED ABOVE AND MENTIONED IN PERSON MUST BE CLEANED. COCKROACHES WILL EAT GREASE, DEAD COCKROACHES, AND ALL FOOD RESIDUE AROUND THE FACILITY.

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED DOZENS AND DOZENS OF CARDBOARD BOXES THROUGHOUT FACILITY BOTH BROKEN DOWN AND WHOLE. OBSERVED GREASE AND FOOD RESIDUE ON PLUMBING AND BEHIND/UNDERNEATH EQUIPMENT. OBSERVED CRAWFISH LEGS ALL OVER FLOOR AND NONFOOD CONTACT SURFACES THROUGHOUT THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. GET RID OF ALL THE CARDBOARD. THROW AWAY ALL FOIL AND CARDBOARD LINING SHELVES, AND CEASE LINING SHELVING TO AVOID CLEANING. ALL GREASE AND FOOD RESIDUE MUST BE REMOVED AND CLEANED FROM ALL SURFACES INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO POTS/PANS, EQUIPMENT, FLOORS, WALLS, UNDER EQUIPMENT,SHELVING, PLUMBING FIXTURES.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped COCKROACHES were found on the premises. OBSERVED DEAD COCKROACHES ON DOZENS OF STICKY AND BAIT TRAPS THROUGHOUT FACILITY (UNDER PLUMBING, ON SHELVING, UNDER EQUIPMENT, IN HOT WATER HEATER ROOM
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. THROW AWAY STICKY TRAPS THAT CONTAIN DEAD COCKROACHES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.observation: The following utensil was observed in a state of repair and condition preventing effective maintenance and cleaning/sanitization: OBSERVED THREE WOODEN PADDLES THAT WERE FRAYING WOOD AND WERE USED TO STIR FOOD.
violations.corrective_action: Utensils shall be maintained in a state of repair or condition that complies with the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2 or shall be discarded. DISPOSE OF WOODEN PADDLES AND ONLY UTILIZE NSF APPROVED UTENSILS OR THE EQUIVALENT.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. LIVE CRAWFISH & SEAFOOD (Inspection Date: 01/08/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. OBSERVED FOOD STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK IN FREEZER AND KITCHEN.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Single service take out containers were observed stored with no protective packaging face up.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used. PIC FLIPPED OVER THE SINGLE SERVICE CONTAINERS.
